# Feature Request Template

> If you need more information about how to fill in this template, read the [contributing guide](https://messagecrate.app/docs/developer/contributing/).
>
> This template includes writing instructions and boilerplate text that you can customize, use as-is, or completely replace with your own text. This text is indicated in {curly brackets}. Make sure you replace the placeholders with your own text.

## Title

{A description of the request using key words relating to the change. 50 to 80 characters recommended. Description should cover the capability, the action, and the location (if relevant).}

## Summary (optional)

{If the title is insufficient for summarizing the request, use the summary to detail the request as concisely as possible. 3-4 sentences recommended.}

## Problem

{Describe the current limitation or gap. Explain what a person cannot do today, or what is harder than it should be. Avoid assuming a specific implementation.}

## Proposed solution

{Describe the capability or change that would address the problem. Include the expected result after the change exists.}

## Alternatives considered (optional)

{List other approaches that were considered and why they were not preferred. Include workarounds that exist today.}

## Who this helps

{Identify who would use the change and in what situation. Examples: a person importing an iPhone backup, a person converting JSONL to MBOX, a person running the server in Docker.}

## Additional context (optional)

{If any additional context is required, detail that context here. Include mockups, related issues, or links if they help explain the request.}

{Please keep in mind the project team may need additional clarification after the request is submitted.}
